page.layout: One page of text in a single column of entries, with a verb list in Latin and German glosses in black letter, running to the right edge of the scan. Running head at top centre. Catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Meto , ich schneide mit der sichel ab / ich erndte/
Nubo, ich bedecke / ich nimme einen mann / nupsi,
Negligo, ich verseumne / verachte/ neglexi, negle-
Obolesco, ich komme auß dem gebrauch / obsole-
Offendo, ich stosse an einen/ ich finde/ offendi, of-
Pango , ich steckeein/ich pflantze/ pepigi,& panxi,
Plaudo , ich schlage die hende zusammen/ plausi,

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of several lines (e.g. "nupsi,", "negle-", "obsole-", "of-", "panxi,", "plausi,"); the continuations beyond the scan are not visible and are not transcribed. "(stum." at the right of "nuptum." is partly cut off and uncertain. "kewe", "bzunꞓe" and "läcke" are doubtful black-letter readings. "Pendo," at the lower right is cut off by the scan edge and is taken as the catchword. The gloss "ich spiele/ich verliere" and other German glosses are set in black letter.
